notes.title: BETA UPDATE 1.5.2
notes.notes:
Beta Update 1.5.2

RELEASE DATE: Monday, June 12th

Update Size: ~790.5 MB

NEW FEATURES:

Water is now swimmable
Stamina now drains properly depending on actions (Jumping, Running, Rolling)
Added New Inventory Character View
Added custom trigger box for stating location name and songs to play in specific areas
Added Custom NPCs
Added custom path tracing system for NPCs
Partially added dialogue system for NPCs
Added NPC Jobs, Names Generator
Fixed Player States being Messed up
Added Footstep Sounds for all walking areas
Added Custom Stamina Wheel
Added UE5 Logo to game start
Added NorwinLabs Logo to game start
Added Detail to WaterfallRise
Fixed player location saving in saved games
Added Custom door component that can be opened
Fixed Audio playing while the game is paused
Fixed dropping Items bug
Added money system (Herons)

SMALL CHANGES:

Improved Dev Workflow
Updated UI elements
Added 2nd layer of clouds to Overworld
Updated Game Launching Photos

CHANGES TO COME:

Fully Fledged Gliding/Flying System
Flying Animal(s)

*Alpha-Testers, Patreon Donors, and Kickstarter Supporters will have access to this update

notes.title: Beta Update 1.3
notes.notes:
Another Beta update was just posted!

Beta Update 1.3

Update Size: 308.7MB

NEW FEATURES:

- Inventory System is Completed
- Added Hover Tooltips for Items
- You can now place down items (Chests)
- You can now drag and drop items from the inventory
- Added a version tag at the top of the screen for ease of debugging during Beta
- New Terrain Generation Layout
- Many bug fixes (Thanks for reporting)

SMALL CHANGES:

- Tweaked world generation
- Edited foliage spawning / working on the world generation system
- Game movement should be much smoother
- FPS should be more stable

CHANGES TO COME IN THE NEXT UPDATE:

- Water will become swimmable
- Combat System will be started
- Animal AI spawning system will be improved

*Alpha-Testers, Patreon Donors, and Kickstarter Supporters will have access to this update
